citations.quote: a) a SKU-level demand forecasting engine (approx. 1,900 SKUs, weekly granularity, 13-week horizon
b) depot-level replenishment and expiry-risk recommendations
c) secondary-sales and chemist-level analytics dashboards in Power BI; and

In consideration of the Client sharing its depot-level sales, margin and supplier data, the Service Provider undertakes that, during the Term and for a period of twelve (12) months after the expiry or termination of this Agreement (the "**Restricted Period**"), neither the Service Provider nor any of its Affiliates shall, directly or indirectly, provide any Restricted Services to any Competing Business

Competing Business**" means any person or entity, other than the Client and its Affiliates, engaged (wholly or in part) in the wholesale distribution, stockist operations, carrying-and-forwarding or third-party logistics of pharmaceutical products in India

Restricted Services**" means demand forecasting, inventory or replenishment optimisation, secondary-sales analytics and depot performance analytics, and any substantially similar data analytics services

findings.counterPosition: Seek a waiver or consent from Kestrel Pharma Distribution Pvt Ltd prior to signing this agreement.
